thread:
devops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected from mid-atlantic edge pool 'shadow-pool-3' (5xx spike to 12% over baseline; p95 latency +420ms). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/alerts/6554443210 :rotating_light:

morgan.sre: ack — I'm on it, paging eng and infra. tagging as P1, paging@oncall.

pager: On-call: morgan.sre (SRE) — acknowledged.

morgan.sre: Quick triage: conn RSTs are up from proxy instances in shadow-pool-3. Upstream ELB shows increased 502s and TCP resets. KVS/redis latency looks normal. No memory pressure on ML workers. Hypothesis: edge proxy connection exhaustion after recent shard remap.

hannah-eng: any recent rollouts? I see an infra rollout for cache-shard-mapping that completed ~12:07 UTC (infra-deploy/2026-03-15-1207). Could be increased fanout to origin.

morgan.sre: Confirmed -- cache shard remap was applied at 12:07. Starting rollback to previous mapping now.

devops-bot: Rollback job infra-deploy/2026-03-15-1207 -> rollback initiated by morgan.sre. CI job #8542.

leah-support: Customer impact: two enterprise customers (acct: AcmeCloud, NovaApps) opened support tickets reporting 502s on long-gen requests. Marking impacted-customers: moderate. CSMs notified.

morgan.sre: Running targeted probes against edge proxies to validate connections:
```
# probe health
curl -sS -D - https://edge-shadow-3.internal/_health | head -n 20
# tcp dump quick
sudo timeout 10 tcpdump -i any 'tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-rst) != 0' -w /tmp/rst.pcap
```

morgan.sre: Logs: seeing many repeated 'too many open connections' from proxy process, ephemeral port exhaustion on proxy host, and some slow upstream handshakes. Looks like connection pooling knob too low for the new shard fanout.

hannah-eng: Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) increase proxy conn_pool_max from 1k -> 2k, 2) enable traffic steer for 30% of mid-atlantic traffic to us-east-2 shadow pool, 3) disable aggressive shard fanout (already rolling back). Patch snippet:
```
# kubectl patch (proxies)
kubectl -n edge patch deployment edge-proxy-shadow-3 -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"proxy","env":[{"name":"CONN_POOL_MAX","value":"2000"}]}]}}}}'
```

morgan.sre: Applying conn pool patch now. Patching via k8s and restarting 3/6 proxies one at a time.

ops-lead: I'll open traffic-router change to shift 30% to us-east-2. Use temporary steer window 15m then reassess.

devops-bot: Traffic-steer job created: steer/6554443210 -> target us-east-2, weight 30%, ttl 900s.

morgan.sre: Patch succeeded on 1/6 proxies (rolling). Seeing immediate reduction in RSTs on that host.

hannah-eng: Also recommend bumping system ephemeral port range on proxy hosts to avoid transient exhaustion (sysctl net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range). I'll push an Ansible change to edge-hosts.

morgan.sre: Traffic steering live. 5xx rate dropped from 12% -> 4.5% within 90s. p95 latency improving. Monitoring closely.

leah-support: Notifying affected customers with interim note: we're investigating elevated 502 errors in mid-atlantic region; we have partially rerouted traffic to alternate pool and are rolling back a recent cache shard change. ETA next update 15m. (CSMs pinged) :email: 

sam-ml: Noted that impacted requests were long-running streaming generations (~>60s). Could be connection reuse/keepalive interaction with proxies and long-lived KV cache lookups. Will add streaming test cases to the regression run.

morgan.sre: Rolling restart finished. All proxies conn_pool_max increased. Steer still 30%. Current 5xx is 1.6%, trending toward baseline.

devops-bot: Alert status: mitigation in progress. Silence alerts for this group for 10m to avoid noise.

hannah-eng: Follow-up: I reverted the cache-shard mapping and disabled the remap job so it doesn't reapply. Confirmed no further shard-related rollouts scheduled.

ops-lead: Good. Also adding a temporary circuit-breaker in traffic-router so any single pool >5% 5xx triggers immediate rollback to multi-region routing.

morgan.sre: Observed reduction to 0.9% 5xx and latency back near baseline. Keeping the traffic steering in place for additional 20m to ensure stability.

sales-cs: Heads-up: two enterprise customers impacted. Will send follow-up comms after RCA scoping. Need incident timeline for customer-facing summary.

morgan.sre: Action items captured: 1) postmortem with timeline and root cause (cache-shard remap increased origin fanout -> proxy conn exhaustion + ephemeral port pressure), 2) infra change: increase default conn_pool_max and ephemeral port range on edge hosts, 3) add regen tests for long streaming requests, 4) safety gate to block shard remap during peak hours + rollout canary.

leah-support: I'll open CS ticket bundle and schedule a sync with the two customers tomorrow 14:00 UTC.

morgan.sre: Closing pager for now but keeping this thread open for 30m. Tagging incident label: partial-mid-atlantic-edge-fanout. Will post runbook link and assign RCA owner (hannah-eng).

hannah-eng: I'll own RCA and schedule follow-up with infra within 48h.

devops-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Next automated check in 10m.

morgan.sre: Thanks team. If we regress we'll reopen. For doc: runbook used -> docs/runbooks/edge-conn-exhaustion.md.

leah-support: Noted, prepping customer-friendly summary.

sam-ml: Adding regression tests to next CI run and a short note to model onboarding checklist about streaming load testing.

morgan.sre: FINAL: 5xx returned to <1% and p95 latency within SLA. Closing incident channel in 30m unless new signals. :white_check_mark:
